page.content:
Owner who bought Pixar from Lucasfilm and later sold it to Disney.

How Steve Jobs connects

  • Topic: Pixar — Steve Jobs owned and funded Pixar from 1986 until the Disney sale.
  • Event: Disney acquisition — Jobs sold Pixar to Disney and joined Disney's board.

What is Steve Jobs?

Steve Jobs acquired the Pixar computer business in 1986, funded the years before Toy Story, and sold the studio to Disney in 2006.
